scripts.dev: npm run build -w @induction/shared && concurrently -n shared,api,staff,candidate -c gray,green,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @induction/shared" "npm run dev -w @induction/api" "npm run dev -w @induction/web" "npm run dev:candidate -w @induction/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @induction/shared && npm run build -w @induction/api && npm run build -w @induction/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @induction/shared && npm run typecheck -w @induction/api && npm run typecheck -w @induction/web
scripts.db:seed: npm run build -w @induction/shared && npm run db:seed -w @induction/api
